metadata.title: Canonical Superstring Massive Spectrum and D=11 SO(10) Multiplets
metadata.theory: 10D Green-Schwarz Open Superstring / D=11 M-theory Compactification
metadata.algorithm_statement: Ab initio evaluation of the GS partition function, lexicographic polynomial division by (8_v + 8_s), D_4 Weyl character inversion, B_4 -> D_4 branching inversion, and D_5 -> B_4 exact linear integer programming lift.
